kangaroo.definitionKo: 호주 및 그 주변의 여러 섬에서 살며, 암컷은 새끼를 낳아 배에 달린 주머니에 넣어서 기르는 동물.
kangaroo.englishDescription: An animal living in Australia and many of its surrounding islands, of which the female raises a baby in its pouch.

katusa.definitionKo: 한국에 머무르고 있는 미국 육군에 소속된 한국 군인.
katusa.englishDescription: Korean soldiers who serve with the U.S. army stationed in Korea.
katusa.englishExpression: KATUSA; Korean Augmentation to the United States Army

keep guard.definitionKo: 일정한 곳에서 적이나 사물의 움직임이나 상태를 살피거나 감시하다.
keep guard.englishDescription: To look or monitor the movement of the enemy or an object at a certain location.

keyboard.definitionKo: 피아노나 오르간 같은 악기에서 손가락으로 누르거나 두들겨 소리를 내도록 하는 부분.
keyboard.englishDescription: A part on a musical instrument like a piano or organ made to press or hit to make noise.
In a computer, the board of keys that is used to input letters or signs.

keyboard.definitionKo: 컴퓨터나 시계 등에서 글자나 숫자, 기호가 적힌 판.
keyboard.englishDescription: A board with buttons for letters, numbers or symbols, and which is used as part of a computer or watch.

keyboard.definitionKo: 컴퓨터나 타자기에서, 손가락으로 쳐서 입력하는 글자판.
keyboard.englishDescription: A keyboard of a computer or typewriter, that inputs characters when pressed with fingers.

keyboard.definitionKo: 피아노나 오르간 같은 악기에서 손가락으로 누르거나 두들겨 소리를 내도록 하는 부분.
keyboard.englishDescription: The part of a musical instrument such as a piano or organ, that makes sounds when pressed or stroked with fingers.
In a computer, the board of keys that is used to input letters or signs.

kkotsin.definitionKo: 꽃무늬나 여러 가지 색깔을 넣어 예쁘게 장식한 신발.
kkotsin.englishDescription: Shoes that are decorated beautifully with floral patterns or different multiple colors.

knotty.definitionKo: 피부나 사물의 표면 여러 군데가 윤기가 없고 매끄럽지 않다.
knotty.englishDescription: One's skin or the surface of an object being lusterless and rough in some parts.

knotty.definitionKo: 물체의 겉 부분이나 바닥이 여기저기 부풀어 올라 고르지 못한 데가 있다.
knotty.englishDescription: The surface or bottom of something being uneven due to protruding parts here and there.

kongjwi patjwi.definitionKo: 조선 시대의 소설. 지은이와 지어진 시기는 알 수 없다. 주인공 콩쥐가 이복동생 팥쥐와 계모에게 구박을 받으나 선녀의 도움으로 어려움을 이겨 내고 감사와 결혼한다는 이야기이다.
kongjwi patjwi.englishDescription: A novel of the Joseon era; the author and period are unknown; it is a story about the heroine Kongjwi who is abused by her greedy stepmother and stepsister Patjwi, but overcomes the hardship with the help of a fairy and then marries a governor.

korean language studies.englishDescription: A discipline that studies the Korean language.

korean terrapin.definitionKo: 거북과 비슷하게 생겼으나 거북보다 작으며, 등이 진한 갈색의 딱지로 되어 있는 동물.
korean terrapin.englishDescription: An animal whose back is a dark brown shell, looking like a sea turtle but smaller in size.

lady.definitionKo: 교양과 예의와 품격을 두루 갖춘 여자.
lady.englishDescription: A woman equipped with refinement, manners, and dignity.

lady.definitionKo: 신분이 높거나 돈이 많은 집안의 부인.
lady.englishDescription: The lady of a rich family or high status.

lady.definitionKo: (가볍게 낮추는 말로) 남남끼리의 성인 여자. 또는 그 사람을 부르는 말.
lady.englishDescription: (impolite form) An adult woman in a group of unknown people. Or a term for calling that person.

lady.definitionKo: 남남끼리에서 성인 여자 어른. 또는 그 사람을 부르는 말.
lady.englishDescription: An adult female adult in a group of unknown people. Or a word used to call that person.

larva.definitionKo: 알에서 나와 다 자라지 않은 벌레.
larva.englishDescription: A young worm not yet grown completely after being hatched from an egg.

late starter.englishDescription: A unit or group that makes a late start.

learning.englishDescription: The act of studying a certain field.

learning.definitionKo: 깊이 생각하여 스스로 이치를 깨달아 알아냄.
learning.englishDescription: The state of realizing and finding out the logic of something by oneself, after thinking about it deeply.

learning.definitionKo: 학문이나 기술 등을 배워서 자기 것으로 만듦.
learning.englishDescription: The act of learning a study, skill, etc., to make it one's own.

learning.definitionKo: 주로 학교에서 지식을 배우기 위해 공부하는 일.
learning.englishDescription: The act of studying to acquire knowledge, usually in school.

learning.definitionKo: 어떤 분야를 체계적으로 배워서 익힘. 또는 그런 지식.
learning.englishDescription: The act of studying a certain field systematically; or such knowledge.

learning by experience.englishDescription: An act of learning through firsthand experience.

leave someone out.definitionKo: 일부러 한 무리에 끼워 주지 않고 골라내거나 제외하다.
leave someone out.englishDescription: To deliberately leave out or exclude someone or something from a group.
leave someone out.englishExpression: exclude; put someone on one side; leave someone out

leave unattended.englishDescription: To leave something abandoned, unattended and ignored.

lethal weapon.definitionKo: 사람을 죽이거나 해치는 데 쓰는 도구.
lethal weapon.englishDescription: An implement used for killing or hurting a person.

letter of appointment.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 남에게 부탁하여 맡긴다는 내용의 문서.
letter of appointment.englishDescription: A document that asks someone to take charge of a task.

ligament.definitionKo: 뼈와 뼈가 맞닿는 부분에 있는, 끈이나 띠 모양의 결합 조직.
ligament.englishDescription: A string or band-shaped connective tissue that joins bones together.

light color.englishDescription: A pale or light shade of a color.

lightning rod.definitionKo: 벼락의 피해를 막기 위해 건물의 가장 높은 곳에 세우는, 금속으로 만든 끝이 뾰족한 막대기.
lightning rod.englishDescription: A sharp, metal rod, which is installed on the top of a building, to prevent damage from lightning.

line segment.definitionKo: 직선 위에 있는 두 점 사이에 한정된 부분.
line segment.englishDescription: A restricted section between two points on a straight line.

lingua franca.definitionKo: 국제적인 기구나 행사에서 공식적으로 쓰는 언어.
lingua franca.englishDescription: A language officially used in an international organization or event.

live idle.definitionKo: 일정한 직업이나 하는 일 없이 놀면서 지내다.
live idle.englishDescription: To live one's life without purpose, idling away without a fixed occupation or job.

local style.definitionKo: 어떤 지방의 자연, 풍속, 정서 등과 같은 특색.
local style.englishDescription: A certain region's characteristics such as natural environment, customs, sentiment, etc.
local style.englishExpression: local color; local flavor; local style

look away.definitionKo: 주의를 기울여야 할 곳이 아닌 다른 데에 관심을 갖다.
look away.englishDescription: To show interest in something that one is not supposed to pay attention to.
look away.englishExpression: look away; look the other way

look away.definitionKo: 마주치기를 원하지 않아서 얼굴을 돌려 피하다.
look away.englishDescription: To turn away one's face in order not to see someone.

lookout hut on stilts.definitionKo: 밭을 지키기 위해 주변보다 높게 지은, 기둥과 지붕이 있고 사방이 뚫려 있는 건물.
lookout hut on stilts.englishDescription: A structure with a roof and pillars without walls, built higher than its surroundings to protect fields.

loosely attached.definitionKo: 가벼운 물건이 살짝 떠서 들려 있다.
loosely attached.englishDescription: A light thing coming off slightly.

lopsidedly.englishDescription: In the manner of squinting one's eyes or crinkling one's nose slightly.

lopsidedly.definitionKo: 눈이나 코를 자꾸 약간씩 찡그리는 모양.
lopsidedly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of squinting one's eyes or crinkling one's nose.

lunacy.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 미친 것처럼 마구 덤비며 거칠게 행동하는 것.
lunacy.englishDescription: (slang) An act of assaulting or acting roughly as if crazy.

make cry.definitionKo: 슬프거나 아프거나 너무 좋아서 소리를 내면서 눈물을 흘리게 하다.
make cry.englishDescription: To make someone make a sound and shed tears out of joy, pain, or delight.
make cry.englishExpression: make cry; move someone to tears

make someone undertake alone.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 혼자서 책임을 지고 모두 다 하게 하다.
make someone undertake alone.englishDescription: To make someone take responsibility for something and do it all by himself/herself.
make someone undertake alone.englishExpression: make someone shoulder alone; make someone undertake alone

make understand.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 말이나 행동 등을 받아들이고 이해하게 하다.
make understand.englishDescription: To make someone accept and understand another person's words or behavior.

making someone left-leaning.definitionKo: 급진적이거나, 사회주의나 공산주의 등의 사상으로 기울어지게 됨. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
making someone left-leaning.englishDescription: The act of leaning or causing someone to lean toward socialism or communism.

manyang.definitionKo: 모양이나 정도가 서로 비슷하거나 같음을 나타내는 조사.
manyang.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used when shapes or levels are similar to each other or the same.

maple leaf.englishDescription: A leaf of a maple tree.

matronly style.definitionKo: 주로 결혼한 중년의 여자들이 입는 옷.
matronly style.englishDescription: Clothing mainly for married, middle-aged women.

mayfly.definitionKo: 여름철 저녁에 떼를 지어 날아다니며 몇 시간에서 며칠 정도로 짧게 사는 벌레.
mayfly.englishDescription: An insect, flying around in swarms in the evening in summer, which lives only a few hours or up to a few days.

measures.definitionKo: 그때그때의 경우에 따라 일을 쉽게 처리할 수 있는 수단과 방법.
measures.englishDescription: A way or method that enables one to handle a certain matter more easily case-by-case according to circumstances.

mediocrity.englishDescription: The state of being ordinary and vulgar.

middle phase.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 일정한 기간의  중간 단계.
middle phase.englishDescription: The middle stage of a task or a time period.

midwife.definitionKo: 산모가 아기를 잘 낳을 수 있도록 도와주며 아기 받는 일을 하는 여자.
midwife.englishDescription: A woman who helps another woman in labor and receives the new-born baby.

midwife.definitionKo: 산모가 아기를 잘 낳을 수 있도록 도와주며 아기를 받는 역할. 또는 그런 역할을 하는 사람.
midwife.englishDescription: The role of helping a woman in labor and receives the new-born baby.

military order.englishDescription: An order made to command military forces.

military trial.englishDescription: A trial that judges a criminal who broke the military law.

military trial.definitionKo: 전쟁 범죄자를 심판하기 위해 열리는 국제적인 재판.
military trial.englishDescription: An international trial held to judge a war criminal.

miniaturization.definitionKo: 사물의 크기가 작아짐. 또는 그렇게 함.
miniaturization.englishDescription: The size of an object becoming smaller, or making something that way.

miscellaneous junk.definitionKo: 여러 가지가 뒤섞여 있는 잡스러운 물건.

molest.definitionKo: 못 견딜 정도로 매우 심하게 괴롭히다.
molest.englishDescription: To severely abuse someone to such a degree that it is hard to bear.

molest.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 신체를 강제로 접촉하여 상대방에게 성적 불쾌감이나 모욕감을 불러일으키는 행위를 하다.
molest.englishDescription: To do something that causes sexual discomfort or insult to the person by forcibly touching another person's body.

monaco.definitionKo: 유럽의 남동쪽 지중해 연안에 있는 나라. 독립국이지만 국방권, 외교권, 공작 임명권을 프랑스가 갖고 있다. 주로 카지노와 우표 판매를 통해 수입을 얻고 있으며 관광 휴양지로 유명하다. 공용어는 프랑스어이고 수도는 모나코이다.
monaco.englishDescription: A country located in the southeast of Europe on the shore of the Mediterranean, famous as a tourist resort; it is an independent country, yet its rights of national defense, diplomacy, and the appointment of a duke are held by France; its major source of income is its casino and the sale of postage stamps; its official language is French and its capital is Monaco.

monstrous.definitionKo: 겉과 다르게 속으로는 엉큼하고 흉악한 데가 있다.
monstrous.englishDescription: A person who looks cunning or heinous with an inside different from his/her outside.

monstrous.definitionKo: 모양이 흉하고 보기 싫게 생긴 데가 있다.
monstrous.englishDescription: A person or animal looking ugly and unpleasant to see.

mother-of-pearl.definitionKo: 빛깔이 아름다워 여러 가지 장식으로 쓰는, 전복 등의 껍데기를 자른 조각.
mother-of-pearl.englishDescription: The piece of an abalone shell, used as decorative material because of its beautiful colors.

mound.definitionKo: 야구에서, 투수가 공을 던질 때 서는 자리.
mound.englishDescription: A slightly elevated ground from which a pitcher throws a ball.

mourning clothes.definitionKo: 삼베로 만들거나 검정색 또는 흰색으로 되어 상중인 사람이 입는 옷.
mourning clothes.englishDescription: A dress made of hemp fabric, or colored in black or white that one wears during the period of mourning.

mouth infection.englishDescription: A disease that occurs in the mouth.

move rhythmically.englishDescription: To move while repeating it by a certain rule.

mulkimchi.definitionKo: 국물의 양을 많게 하여 담근 김치.
mulkimchi.englishDescription: Watery kimchi, made with plenty of water, as well as other ingredients.

munin.definitionKo: 옛날에, 학문을 익혀 관직에 오른 사람.
munin.englishDescription: scholar-official: In  old times, a person who comes to  hold a government position by pursuing study.

museum.definitionKo: 유물이나 예술품을 수집, 보관, 전시하여 사람들이 보거나 연구할 수 있게 하는 장소.
museum.englishDescription: A place in which relics or pieces of art are collected, stored, exhibited so that people can see or study.

mutual acquaintance.definitionKo: 여러 사람을 통하여 서로 알게 된 사이.
mutual acquaintance.englishDescription: Someone or something one gets to know through other people.

nagger.definitionKo: 필요 이상으로 듣기 싫은 말을 하며 꾸짖거나 참견하는 사람.
nagger.englishDescription: A person who rebukes someone or interferes in his/her affair while saying unnecessary things that he/she does not want to hear.

narrow down.englishDescription: To reduce a range or distance.

natural environment.definitionKo: 산, 강, 바다, 동물, 식물, 비 등과 같이 인간 생활을 둘러싸고 있는 자연의 조건이나 상태.
natural environment.englishDescription: The conditions or state of nature like mountains, rivers, oceans, animals, plants, rain, etc., which affect the lives of human beings.

natural gas.definitionKo: 유전이나 탄광 지역의 땅 밑에서 나오며 불에 타는 가스.
natural gas.englishDescription: A type of flammable gas that forms beneath the land of an oilfield or coal-mining area.

natural growth.englishDescription: A phenomenon in which a plant comes out and grows by itself.

natural science.definitionKo: 수학, 물리학, 화학, 생물학, 지구 과학 등의 학문 계통.
natural science.englishDescription: A field of study that includes mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, earth science, etc.

annotations: 주로 수학, 물리학, 화학, 생물학, 지구 과학 등의 학문을 이른다.
natural science.englishDescription: A field of study that studies the phenomena of nature.

navigation.englishDescription: The skill in navigating a ship.
An act of navigating a ship or plane along a certain route.

navigation.definitionKo: 자동차 등이 목적지로 가는 길을 알려 주는 장치나 프로그램.
navigation.englishDescription: A device or program that shows the route to a destination, such as a car.

neatly.englishDescription: In a clean appearance or in a quiet and proper manner.

neatly.definitionKo: 말이나 글씨 등이 분명하고 또렷한 모양.
neatly.englishDescription: In the manner that a remark or handwriting, etc., are clear and distinct.
In the state of being even and neat.
In the state of being in good shape.
In the state of something dirty being cleaned neatly.
In the state of something that was dirty being clean and neat.
In a neat and tidy shape.
In a manner of being clean and organized.

neatly.definitionKo: 작은 것들이 한 줄로 고르게 있는 모양.
neatly.englishDescription: In a manner of a group of small objects being in a single, neat file.

neatly.definitionKo: 말이나 글, 행동 등이 앞뒤가 들어맞고 짜임새가 있게.
neatly.englishDescription: In a manner of speech, text, act, etc., being coherent and organized.

neatly.definitionKo: 외모나 모습 등이 깨끗하고 멋이 있게.
neatly.englishDescription: In a manner of being neat and classy in appearance or looks.

neatly.definitionKo: 여럿이 한 줄로 고르게 있는 모양.
neatly.englishDescription: In a manner of a group of people or objects being in a single, neat file.

neatly.definitionKo: 작은 것들이 한 줄로 고르게 있는 모양.
neatly.englishDescription: In the manner of a group of small people or objects being in a single, neat file.

neatly.definitionKo: 여럿이 한 줄로 고르게 있는 모양.
neatly.englishDescription: In the manner of a group of people or objects being in a single, neat file.

neatly.definitionKo: 물건을 가지런하게 겹쳐 쌓거나 포개 놓은 모양.
neatly.englishDescription: In the manner of objects being stacked or piled in a neat pile.
In the state of having a pleasing, neat, and attractive appearance.
In a manner of being clean and organized in appearance.

neatly.definitionKo: 지저분한 것이 없고 말끔하고 깨끗한 상태로.
neatly.englishDescription: In the state of being tidy and clear without dirty things.
With a tidy and clean appearance.

new house syndrome.definitionKo: 새로 지은 건물에서 나오는 물질로 인해 발생하는 두통, 피부염, 수면 장애 등과 같은 병적인 증상.
new house syndrome.englishDescription: Pathological symptoms such as headaches, dermatitis, sleep disorders, etc. caused by substances emitted from newly built buildings.

newcomer.definitionKo: 학교나 직장 등에 새로 들어온 사람.
newcomer.englishDescription: A person who has recently entered a school, company, etc.

newcomer.definitionKo: 어떤 분야의 일을 처음 맡아서 아직 일이 서투른 사람.
newcomer.englishDescription: A person who is new to a task so that he/she is clumsy at it.

newcomer.definitionKo: 새로운 회사나 학교 등으로 옮겨 온 사람.
newcomer.englishDescription: A person who moves to a new company, school, etc.

newcomer.definitionKo: 새로 벼슬에 오름. 또는 그런 사람.
newcomer.englishDescription: The act of newly joining the government; or such a person.
A person who has newly joined a group or organization.

newcomer.definitionKo: 단체나 집단에 새로 참가하거나 들어옴. 또는 그런 사람.
newcomer.englishDescription: The act of newly joining a group or organization, or such a person.

nightingale.definitionKo: 털빛이 노랗고 울음소리가 매우 아름다운 여름 철새.
nightingale.englishDescription: A summer bird with yellow feathers, which sings very beautifully.

north gyeongsang province.definitionKo: 한국의 행정 구역 단위인 도의 하나. 한반도의 동남부에 있으며 산으로 둘러싸인 분지이다. 국내 최대 내륙 공업지를 이루고 있고 주요 도시로는 포항, 경주, 안동 등이 있다.
